authoring: npm run author -- proposal.json; authoritative definitions are REL and process JSON, governed by source/authoring-contract.json
semantics: All three methods read the same selected evidence IDs and claim version.
Conditions are conjunctive equality checks; missing values fail. The first matching rule in descending priority supplies the weight.
Only admitted evidence contributes. Support and challenge are exact millionth-unit integers, not truth probabilities.
Independent sources count distinct source actors explicitly marked independent among admitted items.
Insufficient source count yields Undecided before thresholds are tested. Both thresholds yield Conflicted; support only Accepted; challenge only Rejected; neither Undecided.
scope: These three original published 1.0.0 example methods have non-overlapping matching rules. This bounded projection does not implement arbitrary Claimipedia languages, conflicting priority ties, real submissions, authority, persistence or production adjudication.
verification: 48 vectors captured read-only from the original evaluator: all 16 subsets across three methods. One original evidence family; not scientific confirmation.
browserChecks: Retracted-study removal changes Equal weight to Accepted
Empty evidence gives three Undecided results
Restore all evidence checks all four native inputs
Space toggles evidence; Enter expands reasoning; focus remains on the active control
Responsive stacked cards and no horizontal overflow in the mobile preview
motion: Finite arrival animation and evidence transitions; CSS disables them for reduced-motion preferences. OS-level preference emulation was not performed.
boundary: The production Claimipedia application remains separate. No private runtime, credentials, user evidence or unpublished corpus is included.
